verdict.rationale: Teller is a banking-data API platform, and a product of that kind could plausibly offer a natural-language interface, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows any natural-language command interface, AI assistant, or conversational control. The docs describe only programmatic REST endpoints authenticated with mTLS, a dashboard for configuring webhooks, and a React component for Teller Connect.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
